component.name: xl-Annotate
component.summary: Mark up images and screenshots with arrows, boxes, and text

description.p: xl-Annotate is simple, light markup for images and screenshots, for Linux Mint and the Cinnamon desktop.

ul.li: Arrows, lines, freehand drawing, rectangles, and ellipses
Rough freehand lines, arrows, circles, and boxes tidied into clean shapes
A highlighter, text, and numbered steps
Pixelate to hide passwords and names, a magnifying loupe, and crop
Line and fill colors (solid, sheer, or none), line styles, and shadows

description.p: Marks stay editable until the image is saved. Open it from the menu, from xl-Screenshot, or with "Annotate Image…" when you right-click an image in Nemo.
